home.name: ℂ𝔸𝕊𝕋𝕃𝔼 𝔾𝔸𝕋𝔼
home.description: You stand outside the towering iron gates of the dark castle. Rain pours down as you look up at the ancient stone walls. Your family back home is dying of a mysterious plague, and the only cure lies deep within the King's hidden vault. The gate is cracked open slightly.

barracks.name: 𝔾𝕌𝔸ℝ𝔻 𝔹𝔸ℝℝ𝔸ℂ𝕂𝕊
barracks.description: You slip inside. Rows of empty bunk beds line the walls. The castle guards must be out on patrol! On a wooden table in the center, a guard carelessly left behind a flickering torch.

items.name: torch
items.description: A warm, flickering torch... use it to light up dark rooms!

courtyard.name: 𝕋ℍ𝔼 ℂ𝕆𝕌ℝ𝕋𝕐𝔸ℝ𝔻
courtyard.description: A massive, open-air stone courtyard. Fountains sit frozen in the chill night air. Pathways branch out in all directions. To the west is an armory, to the east is a dark staircase leading down into the dungeons, and north leads deeper into the palace.

armory.name: 𝕋ℍ𝔼 𝔸ℝ𝕄𝕆ℝ𝕐
armory.description: Racks of iron shields and broken spears fill this dusty room. Hanging on the rack is a pristine, sharp steel sword. This might come in handy if you encounter any hostile guards!

items.name: sword
items.description: A light arming sword - can be used to deal significant and consistent damage to your foes!

dungeon.name: 𝕋ℍ𝔼 𝔻𝕌ℕ𝔾𝔼𝕆ℕ
dungeon.description: It is pitch black down here, but you can find your way around. Chains hang from the damp stone walls. In the furthest skeleton-filled cell, you spot a heavy golden vault key sitting on a wall hook.

items.name: key
items.description: A rusted key... with remnants of oddly exorbiant jewels on it...

throne_room.name: 𝕋ℍ𝔼 𝕋ℍℝ𝕆ℕ𝔼 ℝ𝕆𝕆𝕄
throne_room.description: Magnificent velvet banners hang from high stone pillars, and a massive gold throne sits at the end of the hall. A ferocious Elite Guard stands blocking the northern doorway! (Tip: Make sure you have picked up your sword before trying to pass).

vault.name: 𝕋ℍ𝔼 ℝ𝕆𝕐𝔸𝕃 𝕋ℝ𝔼𝔸𝕊𝕌ℝ𝔼 𝕍𝔸𝕌𝕃𝕋
vault.description: You have successfully sneaked past the guards and made it into the King's inner sanctum! Chests of gold glitter all around you. In the center of the room sits a velvet pillow holding a glowing blue elixir: 'The Cure'. Take it and save your family!

items.name: cure
items.description: The magical medicine to heal your family's sickness.
